release_notes:
🎉 ReSeen v1.0.5 Pro Personal Tagging, 24h Spam Observation & Storage Guard:
• Smart Storage Optimization: Removed redundant image duplication, capped Firestore cache to 15MB, and enabled auto-purge of temporary media buffer to keep device storage lean
• Pro Auto-Personal Tagging: Real individual 1-on-1 chats are automatically badged with PERSONAL on Pro tiers
• 24-Hour Spam Sentinel Auto-Revert: Chats flagged as spam are observed for 24h and automatically revert back to normal if no further spam is detected
• Sender Headers & Reply Context: Clean sender names and color-coded quote boxes on all personal and group chats
• Instant Referral Auto-Copy: Website download button automatically copies VIP invite code to clipboard for seamless first-run claim
